U.note: Working 32x32 sandbox with 8 blocks, erase, undo and a Generate button, but opens as a blank dark grid with a tiny, low-contrast toolbar.

V.note: Clean 4-block palette with counts and status text, but the empty checkered world has little visual appeal and few blocks.

W.note: Opens with a pre-built scene of ground, tree, house and water, 3D-bevelled blocks, 9 palette items, and a layout that works well on mobile.

X.note: Tidy, polished toolbar with keyboard hints, but the empty world gives no first impression and the palette is small.

Y.note: Many tools (Place, Erase, Pick, Fill, Grid) and a starter ground layer, but blocks are plain, it has no sky, and the mobile toolbar is cramped.

Z.note: Best looking: textured pixel blocks, sky with clouds, a generated terrain with trees and water, a New world button, and a clean mobile layout.
